home.heroTitle: The first virtual portfolio for nails.
home.heroBody: Find the perfect design, see how it will look on your own nails, and book the right artist with clear pricing and timing.
home.featureDescription: A soft pearl French manicure with a discreet pink shimmer and a mirror finish.
home.howItWorksBody: Three steps for full transparency and a guaranteed result.
home.stepOneBody: Choose a look from the catalogue or start from inspiration you found on Pinterest.
home.stepTwoBody: The system applies the design to your nails and calculates the exact time and expected price.
home.stepThreeBody: You pick a convenient time and the artist confirms the booking.
home.emptyArtists: Portfolios are being prepared. Soon you will find the leading artists in the city here.
home.ctaBody: Pick a design and see the final result before you even walk into the salon.

artist.portfolioEmpty: No looks yet. Add your first one.
artist.tagDrivesAi: these tags drive AI designs and pricing
artist.tagFirstBody: Select at least one style tag so clients see accurate pricing.
artist.permissionBody: Allow photo access to add work to your portfolio.

client.artistsBody: Pick an artist from their portfolio and start trying styles on your own hands.
client.studioIntro: Try a design on your own hands, see the real price, and book.
client.studioBody: Pick a look your artist has actually done, try it on your own hands, see the real price, and book. No app, no account.
client.looksBody: Real work from this artist's portfolio
client.looksEmpty: This artist has not published any looks yet — ask them for their portfolio in the salon.
client.looksSurpriseBody: Let the AI invent something new in this artist's style
client.compareAria: Drag to compare your hand with the AI try-on
client.renderFailed: The try-on render failed. Please try again.
client.designFailed: Could not design a look for you right now.
client.wrongFormat: Please use a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
client.tooLarge: That photo is larger than 12MB. Try a smaller one.
client.bookingFailed: We could not send your request. Please try again.
client.loadFailed: We could not load this booking.
client.stepOneBody: Flat, even light · fingers spread · no filters. This is what the AI designs on.
client.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP · up to 12MB
client.stepThreeBody: We only combine techniques your artist already does — never a Pinterest fantasy.
client.stepThreeBodyPicked: We keep the look you picked and paint it on your own hands.
client.surpriseButton: Surprise me in my artist's style
client.tryThisLook: Try this look on my hands
client.needsPhoto: Add a hand photo first — the AI designs directly on it.
client.renderStepTwo: Layering the design onto your hand…
client.designOnlyNote: The design is saved — retry the render, or book it as-is and your artist will confirm the exact finish on the day.
client.stepFourBody: No payment now. Your artist reviews the render and confirms the slot.
client.generateForPrice: Generate a design to see the price breakdown.
client.noSlotsToday: No slots left today — please pick another day.
client.needsDesign: Generate a design to unlock booking.
client.bookedBody: Your artist has it now. Keep this screen to follow the confirmation.
client.statusPendingBody: Your request just landed in your artist's inbox. This screen updates itself.
client.statusConfirmedBody: You're booked in. Bring bare or lightly polished nails.
client.statusCounterBody: Your artist suggested a different time or price. Review it below.
client.statusRejectedBody: No hard feelings — message your artist to find another slot or tweak the design.
client.linkExpiredBody: Ask your nail artist for a fresh booking link.
client.keepLink: Keep this screen — it is the only way back to your booking.

search.title: Search by photo
search.body: Upload a photo of the nails you like — from your camera, Pinterest or anywhere else — and we will find artists whose real work matches it.
search.formats: JPG, PNG or WebP · up to 12MB
search.noResults: We could not match that photo to a published portfolio yet. Try a clearer close-up, or browse all artists.
search.noAnalysis: No recognisable nail style in that image.
search.error: We could not analyse that image. Please try another.

book.title: Book an appointment
book.body: Pick an artist, try a style on your own hands and send a request — the artist confirms the slot.

notd.title: Manicure of the Day
notd.body: A fresh nail-art composition, drawn directly inside the nail. Tap Surprise Me to create another.

confirm.expiredBody: Ask your nail artist for a fresh booking link.
